notes: All 5 documents were coded delegates by both coders. Main disagreements: (1) phase, course-start vs before-course/general/during-work for syllabus-communication and accountability statements, resolved by whether the passage communicates expectations (course-start) or governs the work (during-work); (2) unit_stance, where one coder marked disclosure/accountability and rationale units as permit or restrict and the other neutral, resolved to permit for disclosure conditions on allowed use, neutral for accountability duties and rationale, prohibit for items under a Prohibited heading; (3) modality, may vs informs for illustrative examples and evidence lists (informs) and must vs should for imperative list items; (4) actor, all vs admin vs instructor, resolved by who the sentence binds, with general principles coded all; (5) policy_type close calls (P06 vs P19 for 'only if explicitly permitted', P50 vs P05 for the data matrix, P25 vs P26 for recording AI use, P56 vs P50 for the purpose-section duty). Alignment: automatic matching by anchor position, with a few manual corrections where neighbouring bullets had been paired wrongly (those are counted as unmatched in both lists). Units found by only one coder were mostly real list items or definitions the other coder skipped; all but two (a generic opening sentence about learning together, and a Zoom waiting-room instruction not about AI) were kept. Only_A/only_B counts are after the manual corrections.
